summary: Indaptus Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting a September 8, 2026 Stock Purchase Agreement for a private placement of 20,338,974 common shares at a price equal to the Nasdaq Minimum Price plus $0.015 per share, for gross proceeds of roughly $24.0 million. The Nasdaq Minimum Price is the lower of the prior-day close and the five-day average close. Closing is expected within fifteen business days, subject to customary conditions, with net proceeds earmarked for working capital, R&D, and general corporate purposes, potentially including early-stage neurotechnology research. No advisor or board recommendation is named. Watch resale registration timing, pricing relative to market, and dilution overhang.
